## Summary

Describe the change and why it belongs in BluMach.

## Evidence or design rationale

Link the manufacturer documentation, contemporary sources, observed hardware,
validation records or interface rationale used for this change. Mark conclusions
as documented, observed, inferred or hypothetical where relevant.

## Validation

List the exact build, host, machine configuration and tests performed, including
failed or incomplete checks.

## Checklist

- [ ] I documented known approximations and unresolved limitations.
- [ ] I did not include ROMs, proprietary software or other restricted assets.
- [ ] I preserved existing authorship and copyright notices.
- [ ] I updated translatable English and Spanish text where applicable.
- [ ] I confirmed whether the change also applies to unmodified 86Box.
